trend_regime.established: Directional EMA20/EMA50/SMA200 ordering on 1H plus matching completed 4H ordering and EMA20-side close
trend_regime.emerging: Directional EMA20/EMA50 ordering, aligned 1H EMA50 slope, price on the directional SMA200 side, plus matching completed 4H EMA20/EMA50 ordering and EMA20-side close

market_regime.definition: V3 1H/4H BTC contradiction veto remains. Before any V4 publication, the latest completed BTC 15m candle is used only as a hard contradiction veto: block LONG only when BTC is fully bearish (close < EMA20 < EMA50) with EMA20 declining; block SHORT only when BTC is fully bullish (close > EMA20 > EMA50) with EMA20 rising. Neutral/mixed 15m structure does not veto. Missing 15m evidence fails closed.

portfolio_safety.ranking: Least stretched candidate first: lower recent-run ATR, then lower source EMA20 extension, then established before emerging, then symbol.

directional_circuit_breaker.rule: Pause a direction when two recent V4 published signals reach -0.5R before +0.5R. The opposite direction remains eligible.

portfolio_safety.active_reference_definition: Published V4 reference plans whose scaled outcome is still open; a published plan without an analytics row counts as active.

ai_role: Asynchronous evidence review and explanation; cannot originate or change a signal
execution: Signals and operator state only; no exchange orders
status: Production v4 candidate; V3 anti-chase/scaled-target logic plus BTC 15m timing veto, two-signal directional concentration cap and deterioration circuit breaker
